name: Dubthach

attributes.attribute: pagan chieftain and father of St. Brigit
gave away her father's bejeweled sword to a beggar
name given to Brigit's father in Scotland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Christian legend names Dubthach as the pagan chieftain who fathered St. Brigit. He consorted with her Christian mother, a slave in his court. Anecdotes tie Brigit to disputes with her father. She gave his bejeweled sword to a beggar. To stop him finding a husband for her, she caused her eyes to pop out and dangle on bloody threads. In Scotland Brigit's father was called Dugall Donn.
